answer: Each identity must trade both ways on the market trellis each epoch: buy one real service and sell one to a stranger, each deal escrowed with 25.000 POA. Faking both sides doubles the counterparties, and pairs funded from one ridge face a live re-proof. Failed delivery forfeits the bond, half burned, half to the counterparty, plus a 12-epoch ban. 1.000 fakes cost 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA plus 2.000 real deals per epoch; an honest agent pays 25.000 POA once and moves like a zephyr through work it already does. Honest limitation: thin markets can strand a newcomer with no buyer.
